summary: Lolo National Forest log and frame cupola cabin; 1921 and 1923 newspapers, quoted on Rex's page, refer to a lookout on the peak before the 1928 build date. Destroyed in 1968 per firelookout.com.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1968 (firelookout.com); Rex's page says removed, undated. No source describes the site today.

access.note: No source describes access to the peak today.

events.note: Station described as still to be built (Billings Gazette, Sept. 1, 1921, quoted on Rex's page)
Described as a combination lookout (Missoulian, Sept. 22, 1921, quoted on Rex's page)
Carter Kem of Indiana on the lookout that fire season (Daily Missoulian, Sept. 10, 1923)
Jack Thurmond of Georgia to be stationed for the summer (Daily Missoulian, June 22, 1926)
Destroyed in 1968 (firelookout.com); Rex's page says Removed, no year

evidence.supports: log and frame cupola cabin built 1928, destroyed 1968
evidence.quote: This log and frame cupola cabin, built in 1928, was destroyed in 1968.

evidence.supports: Sept. 1, 1921: station to be built on Quigg peak
evidence.quote: A lookout station will be built in the Missoula forest on Quiggs peak.
At Quigg peak, north of the Rock Creek ranger station, there is a combination lookout.

evidence.supports: Sept. 10, 1923: Carter Kem of Indiana on the lookout this fire season
evidence.quote: who has been on Quigg's Peak lookout this fire season

evidence.supports: June 22, 1926: Jack Thurmond of Georgia to be located at the lookout for the summer
evidence.quote: will be located at Quiggs Peak lookout for the summer months.

evidence.supports: Rex's page lists the site as Removed

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives destruction in 1968; Rex's page says Removed with no date. The story reports both.

firelookout.com dates the cabin to 1928, but 1921 and 1923 items quoted on Rex's page refer to a lookout on the peak, and the 1921 Billings Gazette item calls it still to be built. The story reports both and says no source explains the gap.

sources.title: Quigg Peak - Forest Lookouts (Rex's Fire Lookout Page)

notes_for_editor: Built date conflicts: firelookout.com says 1928, while 1921 and 1923 newspaper items (as transcribed on Rex's page, not checked against the originals) mention a lookout earlier. The 1968 destruction comes from firelookout.com alone. Staffing years come from the newspapers. The 1921 Billings Gazette item says 'Missoula forest'. Search found no other Quigg lookout history, so the story stays short. Brief record (gone, ground, Lolo NF) is consistent; no corrections.
